Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

SPECIFICATION FOR 
FIXATION HOOK, EYE, GUTHRIE'S PATTERN 



0) 

S? 



1. Scope — Covers dimensional and other requirements for Guthrie's pattern fixation hook used In 
eye surgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 




All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 FIXATION HOOK, GUTHRIE'S PATTERN 

2.1 A deviation of ± 25 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 
3. Material 



3.1 Hook — Shall be made of stainless steel conforming to 
IS : 6603-1972 Specification for stainless steel bars and flats. 



Designation 20Cr13 or 30Cr13 of 



3.2 Hancf/e — ShaW conform 
surgery ( first revision ). 



to IS: 7783-1981 General requirements for handles, instruments, eye 



4. Requirements — The hook shall be finished smooth and shall be free from burrs, pits, cracks, etc. 
The edges shall be even and rounded off. The shank of the hook shall be fixed to type H 1 (single 
ended) handle conforming to IS : 7783-1981. When the shank is fixed to handle of Type HI, the 
collar diameter shall be 3'2 mm. The silver soldering of the shank of the hook with the handle 
after push fitting shall be neat and sound. The hook shall be polished bright and passivated. The hook 
shall be uniformly hardened and tempered. 

5. Hardness — 380 to 420 HV. 

6. Corrosion Resistance Test — The hook shall satisfy the boiling and autoclaving test as specified 
in IS : 7531-1975 Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel 
surgical instruments. 



7. Marking — Each instruments shall be 
trade-mark and the country of manufacture. 



marked with either the manufacturer's name or initials or 



7.1 IS! Certificatior) Marlcing — Details availabte with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — Each instruments shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or packed in a polyethylene 
bag avoiding contact with one another. The hooks may also be packed as agreed to between the 
purchaser and the supplier while packing the tip of the hook shall be suitably protected. 



Adopted 31 January 1983
